catalog: USGS ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat), FDSN event web service
mw_family_definition: magType (lower case) in mi, mw, mwb, mwbe, mwc, mwp, mwr, mws, mww

columns.depth: hypocenter depth, km, positive down, as served; negative values place the hypocenter above the depth datum and are kept
columns.magType: magnitude type of the preferred magnitude (e.g. mww W-phase moment magnitude, mb body-wave, ms surface-wave)
columns.net: network that contributed the preferred origin (e.g. us = USGS National Earthquake Information Center)
columns.id: ComCat event id (net + network event code)

license: USGS data are in the public domain (https://www.usgs.gov/information-policies-and-instructions/copyrights-and-credits)
note: ComCat is revised continuously (relocations, magnitude updates, deletions); a rebuild on another day can change rows and the hash.
